name: What specific steps are involved in implementing AEO for a local business?

mainEntity.name: What specific steps are involved in implementing AEO for a local business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing AEO involves several key steps. First, optimize your Google Business Profile with accurate and comprehensive information, including services, hours, photos, and Q&A. Second, structure your website content with clear headings and schema markup to help search engines understand key information, making it easier for them to extract answers. Third, identify common questions customers ask about your business or industry and create dedicated FAQ pages or blog content that directly answers these. Finally, ensure consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) information across all online directories and platforms to build authority and trustworthiness for answer engines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include optimizing your Google Business Profile, structuring website content with schema, creating FAQ content, and ensuring consistent NAP information across platforms.
